findings.failure_path: The Host B control is reported as 3/3 GREEN, but ab-cand-hostB-r2.txt says 'Not executed. Read and Bash ... are not available'. The probe also ran with --tools "", so every arm records a planned call sequence, not observed tool behavior. The RED-baseline is therefore false-green and does not show that agent behavior changed.
findings.smallest_fix: Rerun the probe with tools enabled and record the actual tool calls. Until then, record Host B as 2/3 with r2 marked not-executed, and label all arms as stated plans, not observed reads.

findings.failure_path: The summary says the large_skill reads used 'ByteOffset=0 and ByteOffset=46080', but the artifacts show null and 46080. It names claude -p as the harness, while plan.md line 15 says agy -p. The evidence summary does not match its own artifacts.
findings.smallest_fix: Change the summary to match the artifacts (null/46080) and use one harness name in both validation.md and plan.md.

findings.failure_path: AGENTS.md requires a committed conclusive review result in specs evidence for PRs that change skills/. No review artifact is in the diff, so CI's check_review_evidence_present will reject the PR.
findings.smallest_fix: Commit the independent review and challenge result under specs/agy-read-discipline-sync/evidence/ before pushing.

concern_results.conclusion: All four carriers now split the rule the same way: contiguous ByteOffset read_file reads up to its cap and continues to T/Z, and every other read path keeps the <200-line AND <8 KiB chunk limit with a mid-file check. I found no rule-text defect that blocks landing.
Only prose and evidence change. No write, auth or destructive path is touched. Paths without ByteOffset have no exemption from the guard.
A partial read where E<Z still requires reading on to T/Z. Both caps (800 lines and 46,080 B) have a continuation path. I found no gap in the rule text.
The probe evidence is weak. It ran with tools disabled, so the transcripts show planned calls, not observed reads. Host B r2 explicitly says it was not executed, yet it is counted as GREEN.
The scope matches the requester's fix instruction. No new flags or abstractions are added, and anchors and fragments are kept.
This is a pure text change and can be reverted as text. The bridge runtime that verifies these reads already landed.
The size and sync gate tokens are recorded. No operational surface changes.
validation.md overstates the probe. It says 3/3 GREEN, reports ByteOffset=0 where the artifacts show null, and names claude -p where plan.md says agy -p.
Shared-gate session-start.md stays at 7,794 bytes. The compressed sibling sentences keep their modality and qualifiers, which I checked against the 19-row obligation table.

AGENTS.md requires conclusive review evidence under specs/*/evidence for changes to skills/. The diff has no review-result artifact yet, so check_review_evidence_present would fail until one is committed.
